title: The Silent Market
text: A market where no one speaks. The faceless trade by pointing and nodding, their blank heads tilting. Every stall sells faces: young, old, smiling, weeping, hung on hooks like hams. Some of the faces blink.

options.label: Browse the stalls, and point, and hope you point at the right thing.

outcomes.text: A mask that fits perfectly. It fits a little too well.
You point at the wrong thing, and the seller nods, and takes your coin.

options.label: The bravest breaks the silence, and asks whose faces these are.

outcomes.text: Every head turns, and every face on every hook turns with them.

options.label: The sharpest eye watches who buys what, to learn where the faces come from.

outcomes.text: You learn whose faces they are. Some of them you knew.
